en.title: Tailwind
en.summary: Tailwind Iâ€“III enhances saddles and all 16 colored harnesses. Apply a book at an anvil.
details: Tailwind Iâ€“III enhances saddles and all 16 colored harnesses. Apply a book at an anvil.
Only a player-controlled mount receives the bonus. Each level adds 30% movement speed on horses and camels, 20% on other mounts, and 85% flight speed on Happy Ghasts by default.
The server updates transient attribute modifiers each tick; removing the enchantment or dismounting removes the bonus. A plain ghast harness grants no free boost.

details: Horse armor accepts Protection, Fire Protection, Blast Protection, Projectile Protection, Feather Falling, and Leaping. Other enchantments, including Mending and Unbreaking, are rejected by the source modâ€™s final whitelist.
Armor has an effective enchantability of 15 for vanilla utility enchantments at the enchanting table. Custom riding enchantments remain book-only.

en.title: Registry and Sources
en.summary: The mod keeps simpleriding:tailwind, simpleriding:leaping, the riding_items creative tab, and the unused persistent coordinates BlockPos component for old saved stacks.
details: The mod keeps simpleriding:tailwind, simpleriding:leaping, the riding_items creative tab, and the unused persistent coordinates BlockPos component for old saved stacks.

There are no custom items, blocks, entities, commands, keybindings, recipes, or advancements. Riding books come from loot, librarians, and the creative tab; existing vanilla equipment keeps its vanilla models, textures, names, and sources.
The module uses its own namespace, config file, language keys, generated data, and balance metadata; SimpleBuildingâ€™s existing directories and registry entries remain intact.
